name: Financial Incentives for Certification and Intellectual Property Rights Reimbursement Scheme
benefit:
- Reimbursement of charges to the extent of 100% of actual expenditure per certification. Subject to a combined ceiling of ₹8,00,000/- only for the entire period of the scheme.
- Reimbursement of 50% of the professional fees for registration and fees paid to the registry for registration of Intellectual Property Rights. Subject to a maximum ceiling of ₹15,00,000/- for the entire period of the sche
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be one of the following - (a) An Industrial Unit in all Categories operating in Goa. (b) A Hospital recognized by the Government of Goa and operating in Goa. (c) An Educational Institution recognized by the Government of Goa and operating in Goa. - The applicant must have obtained Certification from Indian Standard Institute (ISI), International Standard Organization (ISO) or any other recognised National/International Certification for quality standards and/or Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs) as accepted by the Task Force Committee. - The applicant must not have claimed this benefit under any other scheme/program of the Government of Goa. - The applicant must not be taking or have taken any benefit under any policy of the Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa.
